description: A single run of counter and a row of laminate booths, all of it lit like an interrogation and none of it clean. Behind the pass, an auto-griddle sizzles on its own until the cook leans in and overrides it out of spite. A jittering neon menu offers things in quotation marks — the "eggs," the "melt" — and a card reader waits at every seat, blinking, patient, hungry.
name: Grease Expectations
